summary: Nouveau Monde Graphite Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a settlement of accrued interest via the issuance of 227,924 common shares at US$1.48 per share, totaling US$337,328, to Investissement Québec, a related party. This is a routine debt servicing action under an existing convertible note from 2022, not a special situation. The board relied on exemptions from minority approval and valuation requirements. No structural change, strategic review, or event of significance beyond ordinary course financing. No watch or arb angle applies.
